title: The Inhabited House — Society as Spirit, Mind and Body
purpose: Move the Potato House from structural grammar to populated world-model by defining how concrete social entities, institutions, people, infrastructures, ideas and relationships inhabit the existing Rooms without creating a second ontology.
master_thesis: The symbols are operators and coordinates; the world is the population. Door, Tree, River, Mountain, Garden, Forge, Swamp, House and Axis describe how real relations behave. Governments, companies, banks, families, churches, NGOs, universities, media, technologies, ecosystems, philosophies, artworks, people and events are the entities and records being described.

spirit.label: Spirit / Meaning / Legitimacy
spirit.question: Why does the entity exist, what does it value, what legitimates it, and what meaning does it carry?
spirit.epistemic_boundary: Values, beliefs and narratives can be documented. Calling this 'Spirit' is a project projection and does not imply supernatural agency.

mind.label: Mind / Knowledge / Coordination
mind.question: How does the entity perceive, remember, decide, plan, communicate and learn?
mind.epistemic_boundary: Organizations can process information and coordinate action without being assumed to possess human-like consciousness.

body.label: Body / Matter / Capacity
body.question: What materially instantiates the entity and lets it act in the world?
body.epistemic_boundary: Body is the public triune projection of the repository's Matter / Observable World coordinate.

crosscutting_rule: Every substantial real-world entity may have all three projections simultaneously. Spirit, Mind and Body are views of one entity, not three copies or three ownership records.

relationship_first_model.rule: The fundamental unit is the typed relation between records, not the isolated entity.

operator_application.Door: state/context/legal/capability transition: border crossing, licensing, citizenship, initiation, hiring, contract execution, credit approval, API access
operator_application.House: healthy differentiated containment: constitutional order, organization, family, platform, institution, archive or ecosystem with meaningful internal roles and exits
operator_application.Garden: regime producing future independent capacity: education, health, research, resilient infrastructure, social trust, regenerative ecology
operator_application.Farm: regime optimized around harvest/extraction/dependency where applicable; use as mechanism, not a moral label for whole populations
operator_application.River: flows of money, goods, information, energy, people, water or authority
operator_application.Forge: bounded transformation: manufacturing, education, research, legal process, conflict processing, institution-building
operator_application.Swamp: documented entanglement/path-dependence/unresolved recurrence across relationships; never a blanket label for a country or people
operator_application.Mountain: integration/vantage/compression across many records, not intrinsic status superiority
operator_application.Eye: observation/evidence/discernment interface: audits, statistics, journalism, science, courts, monitoring
operator_application.Seed: transferable future capacity: capital, knowledge, skills, infrastructure, institutions, cultural reproduction

room_population.potatoverse-canon: Project-native meanings, operators, theological self-description and structural grammar.
room_population.archive-sources: Documents, datasets, transcripts, attestations, provenance and source lineage.
room_population.time-history: Events, institutional histories, genealogies, reforms, eras and changing relations.
room_population.traditions-texts: Religions, philosophies, scriptures, schools, doctrines, mythologies and interpretive communities.
room_population.science-formal-models: Research institutions, theories, measurements, models, technology and formal methods.
room_population.life-body: People, health, anatomy, populations, families, care systems, organisms and ecosystems.
room_population.world-systems: States, law, government, banks, firms, ownership, trade, infrastructure, geopolitics and public institutions.
room_population.culture-information: Media, platforms, subcultures, art movements, information systems, memory, aesthetics and public discourse.
room_population.works: Books, songs, visual art, software, authored artifacts and creative expressions.
room_population.research-lab: Open questions, competing models, unfinished investigations and source gaps.

page_design_consequence: House overview should show that structure is an interface for real population, not the subject itself.
Spirit/Mind/Body should be lenses/tabs, not mandatory top-level navigation or new owners.
Population families should name concrete society classes and route into existing Rooms.
Named institution anchors should demonstrate the model using sourced examples but not become a hard-coded world catalog.
The World Atlas should carry scale: countries, organizations, companies, infrastructure and relationships.
Symbols should appear contextually on real entities as operators/states/relations, not as decorative badges.

long_term_build.likely_interface: Relational explorer over real entities with switchable Spirit/Mind/Body and operator lenses.
long_term_build.anti_pattern: Do not create one page per symbol and one page per institution if the same graph can render both contextually.
